name: Naveen Duhan
tagline: Building AI-driven bioinformatics systems that translate complex biological data into clear, actionable insight.
summary: I am a bioinformatician focused on computational genomics, host-pathogen interactions, and machine learning for biological discovery. My work blends data science with systems biology to create tools that are practical for researchers and rigorous enough for publication.

Across academia and applied research, I have led projects that span NGS analysis, multi-omics integration, and the development of web resources that make complex data accessible. I enjoy collaborating with interdisciplinary teams to move from data to decisions.
highlights: Deep learning for genomics and protein interaction prediction
Bioinformatics pipelines, databases, and web servers
office: Animal Disease Research and Diagnostic Laboratory

awardSpotlight.description: Recognized for outstanding contributions to bioinformatics research and innovative computational approaches to solving complex biological problems.
